snippet.title: Nelli The Seer - FREE ON STEAM
snippet.description:
Nelli The Seer is a third-person platformer and memory game. Jump, glide and see the future to collect the treasures present in the Templo Mayor. Collect the fragments of the obsidian mirror to show the future to your people.
